qs.q: Which two tools can you use to copy data to Azure Storage? Select TWO.
qs.e: AzCopy (CLI) y Storage Explorer (GUI) transfieren datos a Storage.

qs.q: Which Azure construct is the billing boundary and also an access control boundary?
qs.e: La suscripción es el límite de facturación y de acceso.

qs.q: Which Azure Storage service is best for storing unstructured data such as images and videos?
qs.e: Blob = objetos no estructurados (imágenes, vídeo, backups).

qs.q: A team wants to host a web app and its API using a managed platform with built-in autoscaling and patching. Which service should it use?
qs.e: App Service: PaaS para web apps y APIs.

qs.q: You want VMs to survive the failure of an entire datacenter in a region. What should you use?
qs.e: Availability zones protegen contra fallo de un datacenter completo; los sets, no.

qs.q: Which two services can connect an on-premises network to Azure? Select TWO.
qs.e: VPN Gateway (túnel por internet) y ExpressRoute (privada) conectan on-premises con Azure.

qs.q: You need VMs in two virtual networks to communicate using private IP addresses. Solution: You configure virtual network peering. Does this meet the goal?
qs.e: VNet peering permite comunicación privada entre VNets.

qs.q: Which two are services included in an Azure Storage account? Select TWO.
qs.e: Una storage account incluye Blob, Files, Queue y Table. SQL y Cosmos son bases de datos aparte.

qs.q: What does an Azure Virtual Network (VNet) provide?
o: A private network in Azure where resources can communicate securely
qs.e: VNet = red privada de Azure para comunicar recursos.

qs.q: You need to store rarely accessed data for at least 180 days at the lowest cost and can accept retrieval taking hours. Solution: You use the Archive access tier. Does this meet the goal?
qs.e: Archive: mínimo 180 días, el más barato, con rehidratación de horas.

qs.q: Which scenario describes Microsoft Entra B2B collaboration?
o: Letting consumers sign up to a public app with social accounts
Replicating on-premises servers to the cloud
Inviting external partners to access your organization's resources using their own identities
qs.e: B2B = socios externos. B2C = clientes de tus apps de consumo.

qs.q: Which Azure Storage service is used to store large numbers of messages for asynchronous processing between application components?
qs.e: Queue Storage = mensajes entre componentes.

qs.q: Which service provides virtualized Windows desktops and apps that users can access remotely from any device?
qs.e: AVD = escritorios y apps virtuales en la nube.

qs.q: You need to run a container quickly without managing virtual machines or an orchestrator. Which service should you use?
qs.e: ACI ejecuta contenedores sin gestionar VMs ni orquestador.

qs.q: You need to require multifactor authentication for sign-ins from outside the corporate network. Solution: You create an Azure Policy assignment. Does this meet the goal?
qs.e: Azure Policy gobierna recursos, no inicios de sesión. Para eso se usa Conditional Access.

qs.q: Which Azure service is a fully managed relational database based on the SQL Server engine?
qs.e: Relacional gestionado PaaS = Azure SQL Database.

qs.q: What is an availability zone in Azure?
o: A pair of regions in the same geography
A physically separate location within a region with independent power, cooling and networking
A logical group of virtual networks
qs.e: Las zonas son datacenters separados DENTRO de una región (protegen de fallos de datacenter).

qs.q: Which service is a globally distributed NoSQL database with single-digit millisecond latency?
qs.e: Cosmos DB: NoSQL distribuida globalmente y multimodelo.

qs.q: What is a resource group in Azure?
o: A logical container that holds related resources for an Azure solution
qs.e: Resource group = contenedor lógico; cada recurso está en un único resource group.

qs.q: Which service lets you host your DNS domains and resolve names using Azure infrastructure?
qs.e: Azure DNS aloja dominios DNS.

qs.q: Which blob access tier is optimized for data that is accessed frequently?
qs.e: Hot = acceso frecuente, almacenamiento más caro pero acceso barato.

qs.q: What is the main benefit of Azure region pairs?
o: They double the price of resources
Planned updates are rolled out to one region at a time and recovery of one region is prioritized during a wide outage
They let you avoid using availability zones entirely
qs.e: Region pairs: actualizaciones secuenciales y prioridad de recuperación; sirven para DR.

qs.q: Which two services can you use to run containers in Azure? Select TWO.
qs.e: Contenedores: ACI (simple) y AKS (orquestación). DNS, Key Vault y Cosmos no ejecutan contenedores.

qs.q: Which storage access tier has the lowest storage cost but requires rehydration that can take hours before data can be read?
qs.e: Archive es offline: el más barato, pero con rehidratación lenta.

qs.q: You deploy several VMs and want to protect them from hardware failures and planned maintenance within a single datacenter. What should you use?
qs.e: Availability set reparte VMs en fault domains y update domains del mismo datacenter.

qs.q: Which two are benefits of availability zones? Select TWO.
o: Independent power, cooling and networking per zone
qs.e: Zonas: datacenters separados con infraestructura independiente dentro de una región.

qs.q: You need VMs in two different virtual networks to communicate using private IP addresses over the Microsoft backbone. What should you configure?
qs.e: VNet peering conecta VNets por la red troncal de Microsoft.

qs.q: A government agency must keep data in a region that is isolated for compliance reasons. Which Azure option should it consider?
o: A sovereign region such as Azure Government
qs.e: Sovereign regions (Azure Government, Azure China) están aisladas para cumplimiento legal.

qs.q: Which security approach uses multiple layers, such as physical, identity, perimeter, network, compute, application and data?
qs.e: Defense in depth = varias capas, si una falla, otra protege.

qs.q: Which tier is intended for data that is rarely accessed and stored for at least 90 days?
qs.e: Mínimos: Cool 30 días, Cold 90 días, Archive 180 días.

qs.q: A company wants to keep file shares on its Windows Servers in sync with Azure Files, keeping a local cache for fast access. What should it use?
qs.e: File Sync centraliza shares en Azure Files y cachea localmente en Windows Server.

qs.q: Which graphical tool lets you manage Azure Storage data on your Windows, macOS or Linux computer?
qs.e: Storage Explorer = aplicación con interfaz gráfica.

qs.q: A company has 30 subscriptions and wants to apply governance settings to all of them at once. What should it use?
qs.e: Management groups organizan varias suscripciones y heredan políticas y roles.

qs.q: You need an encrypted connection between your on-premises network and Azure over the public internet. What should you use?
qs.e: VPN Gateway = túnel cifrado por internet público.

qs.q: A company requires a private, dedicated connection to Azure that does NOT go over the public internet. What should it use?
qs.e: ExpressRoute = conexión privada vía proveedor, no pasa por internet.

qs.q: What is an Azure region?
o: A set of datacenters deployed within a latency-defined perimeter and connected through a low-latency network
A single physical building with one server room
qs.e: Region = conjunto de datacenters cercanos con red de baja latencia.

qs.q: Which storage redundancy option keeps three copies of data within a single datacenter?
qs.e: LRS = 3 copias en un único datacenter; la más barata y la menos resiliente.

qs.q: Which Azure service provides fully managed file shares accessible via the SMB protocol?
qs.e: Azure Files = recursos compartidos SMB (y NFS).

qs.q: Which service provides cloud-based identity and access management, including sign-in and single sign-on?
qs.e: Entra ID (antes Azure AD) es el servicio de identidad.

qs.q: Which is the correct hierarchy of Azure organization, from highest to lowest?
o: Subscriptions, management groups, resource groups, resources
Resource groups, subscriptions, management groups, resources
Management groups, resource groups, subscriptions, resources
Management groups, subscriptions, resource groups, resources
qs.e: Jerarquía: management group > subscription > resource group > resource.

qs.q: What is multifactor authentication (MFA)?
o: Requiring two or more verification methods to sign in
Signing in once to access many apps
qs.e: MFA combina algo que sabes, tienes o eres.

qs.q: Which two are passwordless authentication methods supported by Microsoft Entra ID? Select TWO.
o: A password plus an SMS code
qs.e: Passwordless: Windows Hello, FIDO2 y Microsoft Authenticator. Password + SMS sigue usando contraseña.

qs.q: Which redundancy option replicates data synchronously across three availability zones in the primary region?
qs.e: ZRS = tres zonas de disponibilidad de la misma región.

qs.q: A company runs many containers and needs orchestration, scaling and self-healing. Which service should it use?
qs.e: Orquestación de muchos contenedores = AKS (Kubernetes).

qs.q: Which redundancy option combines ZRS in the primary region with replication to a secondary region?
qs.e: GZRS = ZRS en primaria + copia en región secundaria.

qs.q: A company needs a group of identical VMs that automatically increases or decreases in number based on load. What should it use?
qs.e: Scale sets = VMs idénticas con autoescalado.

qs.q: A company needs to move 80 TB of data to Azure but has limited network bandwidth. Which service should it use?
qs.e: Data Box es un dispositivo físico para transferencia offline de grandes volúmenes.

qs.q: Which command-line tool is used to copy blobs and files to and from a storage account?
qs.e: AzCopy = utilidad de línea de comandos para copiar datos a Storage.

qs.q: You want to require extra verification only when users sign in from an unfamiliar location. Which feature should you use?
qs.e: Conditional Access = políticas 'si pasa X, exigir Y' (p. ej., MFA).

qs.q: A company wants to discover, assess and migrate on-premises servers and databases to Azure. Which service should it use?
qs.e: Azure Migrate = centro de evaluación y migración.

qs.q: Which redundancy option copies data to a secondary region and also lets you read from that secondary region at any time?
qs.e: El prefijo RA- (read access) permite leer de la región secundaria; GRS solo la usa en failover.

qs.q: You want a storage account to be reachable only through a private IP address inside your virtual network. What should you use?
qs.e: Private endpoint asigna una IP privada de tu VNet al servicio PaaS.

qs.q: Which service runs small pieces of code in response to events, such as a file being uploaded, without managing servers?
qs.e: Evento + código sin servidores = Azure Functions.

qs.q: You need data in a storage account to survive the loss of an entire Azure region. Solution: You use locally redundant storage (LRS). Does this meet the goal?
qs.e: LRS solo copia dentro de un datacenter. Para sobrevivir a una región necesitas GRS o GZRS.

qs.q: What does single sign-on (SSO) allow users to do?
o: Sign in once and access multiple applications without signing in again
qs.e: SSO = un inicio de sesión para muchas aplicaciones.

qs.q: Which two services are examples of SaaS? Select TWO.
qs.e: SaaS = software completo listo para usar (Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365).

qs.q: A company deploys its app to multiple Azure regions so users in different countries get low latency. Which benefit is this?
qs.e: Desplegar cerca de los usuarios en varias regiones = alcance global / geo-distribución.

qs.q: Which of the following is an example of PaaS?
qs.e: Bases de datos gestionadas y App Service son PaaS; Teams es SaaS; VMs y discos son IaaS.

qs.q: Which cloud benefit ensures an application is accessible with minimal downtime, as guaranteed by an SLA?
qs.e: High availability se mide con SLA (p. ej., 99,99 %).

qs.q: Which two are benefits of using a public cloud like Azure? Select TWO.
o: You must own and maintain the datacenter
Pay only for the resources you use
Fixed monthly cost regardless of usage
Hardware is dedicated to a single customer
qs.e: Nube pública: sin compra inicial y pago por uso. Datacenter propio y coste fijo son del modelo tradicional.

qs.q: Which two services are examples of PaaS? Select TWO.
qs.e: PaaS: tú pones código/datos y Azure gestiona el SO. VMs y discos son IaaS; Microsoft 365 es SaaS.

qs.q: Which type of expenditure is incurred when a company pays monthly for Azure virtual machines?
qs.e: Pago periódico por uso = OpEx. CapEx es el gasto inicial en hardware propio.

qs.q: In a SaaS solution, which of the following is Microsoft responsible for?
qs.e: En SaaS Microsoft gestiona SO y aplicación; el cliente sigue con datos, identidades y dispositivos.

qs.q: A retail company wants to avoid buying servers and instead pay only for the compute it uses each month. Which Azure benefit describes this?
qs.e: Consumption = pagas solo lo que usas, sin gasto inicial. Pista: 'pay only for what you use'.

qs.q: Microsoft can offer lower per-unit prices because it purchases hardware and operates datacenters at massive scale. Which concept is this?
qs.e: Comprar a gran volumen reduce el coste por unidad: economies of scale.

qs.q: Which cloud deployment model is used exclusively by a single organization and is not shared with other customers?
qs.e: Private = una sola organización (puede estar on-premises). Public = hardware del proveedor compartido.

qs.q: Which model lets a company use a service such as email without installing or maintaining any software or servers?
qs.e: Usar el software ya hecho sin mantener nada es SaaS.

qs.q: Which statement best describes capital expenditure (CapEx)?
o: A monthly charge based on usage
Upfront spending on physical infrastructure that is depreciated over time
qs.e: CapEx = inversión inicial en activos físicos. Usa/paga-por-uso es OpEx.

qs.q: Azure Functions bills only while your code runs and you do not manage servers. Which type of computing is this?
qs.e: Serverless: no gestionas servidores y pagas por ejecución.

qs.q: Which two responsibilities are always retained by the customer in every cloud service type? Select TWO.
qs.e: Datos, identidades y dispositivos nunca se delegan; lo físico es siempre de Microsoft.

qs.q: Which cloud model uses hardware owned and operated by a cloud provider and shared by multiple customers?
qs.e: Public cloud: el proveedor posee el hardware y no necesitas comprarlo.

qs.q: A school buys physical servers and builds its own server room. Which type of spending is this?
qs.e: Comprar infraestructura física por adelantado es CapEx.

qs.q: Which statement about the public cloud is true?
o: You must buy and install your own servers
You do not need to purchase or maintain the underlying hardware
Only your organization uses the hardware
It requires a minimum of three datacenters of your own
qs.e: En la nube pública el proveedor posee y mantiene el hardware.

qs.q: Which two are advantages of a hybrid cloud? Select TWO.
o: It removes the need for any on-premises hardware
It guarantees zero latency for all users
Sensitive data can stay in your own datacenter
You can use cloud capacity for peak demand
qs.e: Hybrid combina on-premises (datos sensibles) con nube (picos de demanda). No elimina nada por completo.

qs.q: Which responsibility always belongs to the customer, regardless of the cloud service type?
o: Information and data stored in the cloud
qs.e: Datos, cuentas/identidades y dispositivos son siempre del cliente; lo físico siempre es de Microsoft.

qs.q: A university needs extra computing capacity only during exam season and does not want to buy hardware that sits idle the rest of the year. Which cloud advantage addresses this?
qs.e: Capacidad puntual sin comprar hardware = consumo bajo demanda + escalabilidad.

qs.q: Which of the following is an example of SaaS?
qs.e: Dynamics 365 y Microsoft 365 son SaaS; VMs son IaaS.

qs.q: A development team wants to deploy a web app without managing the operating system or web server patching. Which service type should they use?
qs.e: Quieres desplegar tu código y que el proveedor gestione el SO = PaaS (p. ej., App Service).

qs.q: An online store receives heavy traffic during a sale and then drops back. Resources are automatically added and removed to match demand. Which cloud concept is this?
qs.e: Elasticity = añadir y quitar recursos automáticamente según la demanda.

qs.q: You need to automatically reduce resources when demand falls to lower costs. Solution: You use the elasticity of the cloud. Does this meet the goal?
qs.e: Elasticity añade y quita recursos según la demanda, ahorrando coste.

qs.q: Your company plans to migrate to Azure to reduce capital expenditure. Solution: You move on-premises servers to Azure virtual machines that are billed monthly. Does this meet the goal?
qs.e: Pagar VMs mensualmente convierte CapEx en OpEx, que es el objetivo.

qs.q: A hospital keeps patient records in its own datacenter and runs a public appointment website in Azure. Which cloud model is this?
qs.e: On-premises + nube pública combinados = hybrid.

qs.q: Microsoft 365 is an example of which cloud service type?
qs.e: Si solo usas el software ya hecho (correo, Office) es SaaS.

qs.q: Which practice lets an organization restore operations in a secondary region after a regional outage?
qs.e: Recuperarse de una caída regional en otra región = disaster recovery.

qs.q: You change a virtual machine size from 2 vCPUs to 8 vCPUs. What is this called?
qs.e: Aumentar el tamaño de una sola VM es escalado vertical (scale up).

qs.q: Which cloud service type requires you to manage the guest operating system of your virtual machines?
qs.e: En IaaS (VMs) el sistema operativo invitado y sus parches son tuyos.

qs.q: Which cloud service type gives the customer the LEAST control over the underlying infrastructure and platform?
qs.e: Orden de control: on-premises > IaaS > PaaS > SaaS (el menor).

qs.q: A system detects failures, recovers automatically and continues to function. Which cloud benefit does this describe?
qs.e: Reliability = capacidad de recuperarse de fallos y seguir funcionando.

qs.q: Which scenario best justifies a hybrid cloud?
o: The company wants to avoid using the internet entirely
The company has no datacenter and wants fully managed email
Regulations require data to stay in the company datacenter, while a web front end needs cloud scale
The company wants all operating costs to be zero
qs.e: Hybrid = parte on-premises por requisitos (datos) y parte en la nube por escala.

qs.q: A company wants to move its existing on-premises virtual machines to the cloud with minimal changes (lift-and-shift). Which service type is the closest match?
qs.e: Lift-and-shift de VMs = IaaS, porque mantienes control del SO y de las apps.

qs.q: You increase the number of VM instances behind a load balancer to handle more users. What is this called?
qs.e: Más instancias = scale out (horizontal). Más CPU/RAM en la misma VM = scale up.

qs.q: A company moves from its own datacenter to Azure. Which statement describes the financial impact?
o: Upfront capital costs shift to ongoing operating costs
Costs become fixed regardless of usage
qs.e: Se pasa de CapEx a OpEx: se paga por uso en lugar de comprar hardware.

qs.q: A company can forecast the cost of its Azure workload and anticipate how it will perform under load. Which cloud benefit is this?
qs.e: Predictability cubre rendimiento y coste previsibles.

qs.q: In the shared responsibility model, who is responsible for the physical hosts in every cloud service type?
o: It depends on whether you use IaaS or PaaS
qs.e: Lo físico (datacenter, red, hosts) es siempre del proveedor, sea IaaS, PaaS o SaaS.

qs.q: You need Microsoft to patch the guest operating system of your workloads. Solution: You deploy the workloads on Azure virtual machines (IaaS). Does this meet the goal?
qs.e: En IaaS el parcheo del SO invitado es del cliente. Para delegarlo hay que usar PaaS o SaaS.

qs.q: Which service lets you analyze Azure spending, set budgets and create cost alerts?
qs.e: Cost Management = análisis, presupuestos y alertas de gasto.

qs.q: Which service analyzes your resource configuration and usage and recommends improvements for cost, security, reliability, performance and operational excellence?
qs.e: Advisor da recomendaciones personalizadas en cinco pilares.

qs.q: You need to prevent accidental deletion of a resource group. Solution: You apply a CanNotDelete resource lock to the resource group. Does this meet the goal?
qs.e: CanNotDelete en el grupo evita borrarlo y los recursos heredan el lock.

qs.q: You want to group resources by department so that costs can be reported per department. What should you use?
qs.e: Las tags (p. ej., Department=Sales) permiten agrupar costes.

qs.q: Where can you find Microsoft compliance reports, audit documents and certifications?
qs.e: Service Trust Portal publica informes de auditoría y cumplimiento.

qs.q: Which built-in Azure role can manage all resources but cannot assign roles to others?
qs.e: Contributor gestiona recursos sin asignar roles; Owner sí asigna.

qs.q: Which metric-based capability in Azure Monitor notifies you when CPU usage on a VM exceeds a threshold?
qs.e: Azure Monitor alerts notifican cuando una métrica o consulta supera un umbral.

qs.q: Which two actions can help reduce Azure costs? Select TWO.
o: Purchase reserved instances for steady workloads
Deploy everything to the most expensive region
Use Azure Hybrid Benefit with eligible licenses
qs.e: Reservas y Hybrid Benefit bajan el precio; recursos ociosos o sobredimensionados lo suben.

qs.q: Which Azure tool is a web-based graphical interface for creating and managing resources?
qs.e: El portal es la interfaz web gráfica.

qs.q: You want to see which resource groups or tags are driving spend over time. Which Microsoft Cost Management feature should you use?
qs.e: Cost analysis desglosa el gasto por recurso, grupo o tag.

qs.q: Which Azure Monitor feature lets you write Kusto queries (KQL) against collected log data?
qs.e: Log Analytics = consultas KQL sobre logs.

qs.q: You want to enforce that resources can be created only in specific Azure regions. What should you use?
qs.e: Policy impone reglas sobre propiedades de recursos, como la ubicación permitida.

qs.q: You need to estimate the cost of running VMs before you deploy them. Solution: You use Azure Service Health. Does this meet the goal?
qs.e: Service Health informa de incidencias. Para estimar costes: Pricing calculator.

qs.q: A role assigned at the subscription scope applies to which resources?
o: All resource groups and resources in that subscription
qs.e: Los permisos RBAC se heredan hacia abajo desde el ámbito asignado.

qs.q: Which factor can change the price of the same virtual machine size?
o: The name of the resource group
The Azure region where it is deployed
The display name of the subscription
qs.e: El precio depende de región, tipo de recurso, uso y tamaño; nombres y tags no.

qs.q: You want to identify underutilized virtual machines to reduce spending. Which service provides this recommendation?
qs.e: Advisor detecta VMs infrautilizadas y sugiere reducir o apagar.

qs.q: Which built-in role lets a user manage all resources AND grant access to others?
qs.e: Owner = acceso total + delegar acceso.

qs.q: Which SLA percentage represents the LEAST allowed downtime?
qs.e: Más nueves = menos tiempo de inactividad permitido.

qs.q: You want to estimate the monthly cost of a planned set of Azure services before deploying them. Which tool should you use?
qs.e: Pricing calculator estima el coste de servicios Azure concretos.

qs.q: Which tool shows the health of an individual resource, such as one specific virtual machine?
qs.e: Resource Health = recurso concreto; Azure status = global; Service Health = tus servicios.

qs.q: Which VM option uses unused Azure capacity at a deep discount but can be evicted when Azure needs the capacity back?
qs.e: Spot = capacidad sobrante barata, apta para cargas interrumpibles.

qs.q: What happens to the resources inside a resource group when you delete the resource group?
o: Resources move to the default group
All resources in the group are deleted
qs.e: Borrar el grupo borra todo su contenido (por eso existen los locks).

qs.q: A budget in Microsoft Cost Management reaches its threshold. What happens by default?
o: A notification can be sent, but resources are not stopped
All resources in the subscription are deleted
The subscription is moved to another management group
All virtual machines are deallocated automatically
qs.e: Los presupuestos alertan; no detienen recursos salvo que configures una automatización.

qs.q: You need to restrict which Azure regions can be used to deploy resources. Solution: You assign Azure RBAC roles to users. Does this meet the goal?
qs.e: RBAC controla permisos de usuarios, no ubicaciones permitidas. Eso es Azure Policy.

qs.q: A company wants to compare the cost of running its workloads on-premises with the cost of running them in Azure. Which tool should it use?
qs.e: TCO calculator compara on-premises vs Azure.

qs.q: Which cross-platform command-line tool uses commands that start with 'az'?
qs.e: Los comandos 'az' pertenecen a Azure CLI.

qs.q: Which statement about tags is true?
o: Tags are automatically inherited from the subscription to every resource
Tags prevent a resource from being deleted
By default, tags applied to a resource group are not inherited by the resources in it
A resource can have only one tag
qs.e: Las tags no se heredan automáticamente; puedes usar Azure Policy para aplicarlas.

qs.q: Which is an advantage of infrastructure as code (IaC)?
o: Resources must be created manually each time
Costs are removed from the subscription
It replaces the need for subscriptions
qs.e: IaC repite despliegues idénticos sin pasos manuales.

qs.q: A company wants to apply Azure Policy and tagging to servers running in its own datacenter. Which service enables this?
qs.e: Arc proyecta servidores externos a Azure Resource Manager para gobernarlos.

qs.q: Which two tools can you use to manage Azure resources from the command line? Select TWO.
qs.e: CLI y PowerShell son las herramientas de línea de comandos.

qs.q: Which two areas does Azure Advisor give recommendations about? Select TWO.
qs.e: Advisor: reliability, security, performance, cost y operational excellence.

qs.q: A company already owns Windows Server licenses with Software Assurance and wants to reduce Azure costs. What should it use?
qs.e: Hybrid Benefit reutiliza licencias existentes con Software Assurance.

qs.q: Which type of resource lock prevents users from deleting a resource but allows them to modify it?
qs.e: CanNotDelete evita borrar; ReadOnly impide también modificar.

qs.q: Two services in an application each have a 99.9 percent SLA and both are required for the application to work. What is the composite SLA?
qs.e: Al encadenar servicios dependientes, el SLA compuesto baja (aprox. 99,8 %).

qs.q: Which service monitors the performance and usage of a live web application and detects anomalies?
qs.e: Application Insights es el APM de Azure Monitor.

qs.q: You apply a ReadOnly lock to a resource group. What is the effect on the resources inside it?
o: Only the group itself is locked
Resources inherit the lock and cannot be modified or deleted
The lock is ignored by Owners
Resources can be changed but not read
qs.e: Los locks se heredan por los recursos hijos.

qs.q: Which language offers a simpler syntax than ARM templates and compiles to ARM templates for declarative deployments?
qs.e: Bicep = IaC declarativo que se transpila a ARM.

qs.q: Which two options can you use for infrastructure as code deployments to Azure? Select TWO.
qs.e: IaC en Azure: plantillas ARM (JSON) y Bicep.

qs.q: Which Azure feature enforces a standard set of controls so that all subscriptions under a management group meet organizational requirements?
o: A resource lock on a VM
Azure Policy assigned at the management group
qs.e: Asignar Policy en el management group lo hereda toda suscripción debajo.

qs.q: Which format do Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates use to declare resources?
qs.e: Las plantillas ARM son declarativas en JSON.

qs.q: Which service helps govern and protect data across on-premises, multicloud and SaaS environments by providing data cataloging and classification?
qs.e: Purview = gobierno y cumplimiento de datos.

qs.q: Which feature gives you a browser-based command-line environment that supports Bash and PowerShell?
qs.e: Cloud Shell: shell en el navegador con Bash o PowerShell.

qs.q: What is Azure Resource Manager?
o: A storage tier for archived data
The deployment and management service that all Azure tools use to create and manage resources
qs.e: Portal, CLI, PowerShell y plantillas pasan todos por ARM.

qs.q: You want to be notified when planned maintenance or an Azure service issue affects the services you use. Which service should you use?
qs.e: Service Health avisa de incidencias y mantenimientos que afectan a TUS recursos.

qs.q: A free Azure account provides which of the following when you sign up?
o: A credit to explore services for the first 30 days plus some services free
Free access to all paid support plans
qs.e: Cuenta gratuita: crédito inicial de 30 días y servicios gratuitos limitados.

qs.q: Which service collects, analyzes and acts on telemetry such as metrics and logs from Azure and on-premises environments?
qs.e: Azure Monitor recopila y analiza métricas y logs.

qs.q: What is the main difference between Azure Policy and Azure RBAC?
o: Policy controls user permissions; RBAC evaluates resource properties
Policy evaluates resource properties; RBAC controls what users can do
Policy is used only for identities
qs.e: RBAC = quién puede hacer qué. Policy = qué configuraciones de recursos se permiten.

qs.q: What is generally true of Azure services in public preview?
o: They always have a 99.99 percent SLA
They cannot be used in Azure portal
They are typically not covered by the standard SLA
qs.e: Los servicios en preview normalmente no están cubiertos por SLA.

qs.q: You need to prevent any modification, including updates, to a critical database resource. Which lock type should you use?
qs.e: ReadOnly impide modificar y borrar; CanNotDelete solo borrar.

qs.q: A company commits to using specific VMs for one or three years to receive a discount. Which option is this?
qs.e: Reservas a 1 o 3 años = descuento por compromiso.
